key_reasoning.reason: Eight source components touched: new logout_token_cleanup module (never-raising orchestration plus async timeout wrapper), new ThreadSafeTTLCache utility, TMSTokenStore.purge_fallback_for_user, purge_user_cache on both TokenExchangeService and OIDCTokenExchangeService singletons, is_tool_oauth_enabled helper in oauth_security, and the local-auth and Keycloak logout routers. Two new abstractions and shared token-exchange singletons are involved.

Closest existing pattern is TokenExchangeService.clear_cache(user_id), but it does a TMS delete per principal alias and raises, so it cannot serve a best-effort logout path. The new work adds thread-safety to TTLCache (request threads vs a logout worker thread), an un-cancellable asyncio.to_thread worker bounded by wait_for, and log sanitisation (user id plus exception class name only, since exception text can carry token material). Credential removal on logout is authentication-adjacent. Error-path and concurrency test suites were added alongside.

Diffstat reports 17 files changed (1039 insertions, 12 deletions): 9 source files and 8 test files, at least 5 of them new (logout_token_cleanup.py, thread_safe_ttl_cache.py and three new test modules). The 17-file count falls in the XXL band of the actual-mode mapping, though about half the files are tests. Nearest calibration anchor, epmcdme-10401 (L, total 22), had 8 files. The file-count dimension here reads higher than that example, and the other dimensions offset it.
